adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` on line 22 of groups_controller.rb with no upper bound validation. A malicious caller could pass an extremely large limit value (e.g., limit=1000000) which would cause the database to fetch and serialize an arbitrarily large number of user records in a single request. This is a real security/DoS vulnerability - the code should cap the limit to a reasonable maximum value to prevent resource exhaustion.
